title: MAPF-GPT: Imitation Learning for Multi-Agent Pathfinding at Scale

layout.note: Four dashed frames in a 2x2 grid of unequal widths: stage 3 top left, stage 4 top right, stage 2 bottom left, stage 1 bottom right. The flow snakes clockwise from stage 1: leftwards along the bottom, up the left edge, rightwards along the top.

lesson: Print the dataset size inside a cylinder at every stage of a data pipeline and give each stage a coloured dashed frame with a numbered title, so order and funnel read at a glance. Dots in a label repeated at the arrow starts show which half of a pair each arrow carries.
